text:
anya_cs: heads-up — AcmeSports reported their free trial credits are missing from the main workspace but live on a duplicate workspace. customer said they used SSO twice and now sees credits in 'acme-staging' only. workspace ids: ws_12345 (prod), ws_98765 (staging).

olivia_support: can you drop the customer email/org id so I can contact them? I can start the consent flow. :phone:

anya_cs: sure — org id org_7b9a, email billing@acmesports.com. they tried calls to our API and hit quota errors. quick summary: admin re-initiated SSO, created a second workspace; promo applied automatically to the newly-created workspace.

samir_engineer: ok i'm pulling ledger entries now. @billing_bot ping for balances and grant metadata for both workspaces.

billing_bot: billing_bot: pulled balances for org_7b9a: ws_12345 -> 0 credits, ws_98765 -> 1000 credits (grant id cg_20260301_11, code REDWOOD-TRIAL2026). ledger link: https://billing.internal/ledger/cg_20260301_11. No usage yet.

jordan_ops: if this is SSO duplication the usual path is a workspace merge or manual credit transfer. we have a merge tool but need customer signoff. workaround: reverse grant and re-issue to prod workspace. Finance approval required.

mara_finance: I can approve a reversal + reissue up to $1k with customer consent and audit trail. please include the full grant id and who authorized the request.

samir_engineer: looks like attribution bug: promo attached to the first workspace session after signup when SSO flows should attach at org level. filing bug and proposing hotfix to attribution layer. For immediate fix, here are manual steps we can run once finance & customer approve:

```
# manual transfer (devops/billing only)
# 1) create reversal entry referencing cg_20260301_11
POST /internal/ledger/reversals
{ "grant_id": "cg_20260301_11", "reason": "duplicate_workspace_transfer", "authorized_by": "mara_finance" }
# 2) create new grant to prod workspace
POST /internal/ledger/grants
{ "org_id": "org_7b9a", "workspace_id": "ws_12345", "amount": 1000, "code": "REDWOOD-TRIAL2026", "note": "reissued after duplicate workspace created" }
# 3) confirm balances and notify customer
```

olivia_support: i've sent the consent email and asked for the admin confirmation. they said they'd respond within 4 hours. i'll post the approval here when they confirm.

anya_cs: i'll open a support ticket with audit logs + links to the ledger entry and include the proposed reversal. Samir, please add the bug ticket for attribution. Jordan, please standby for the reversal run.

samir_engineer: filed bug #INF-1429 for misattribution in SSO path and labeled P1. attaching initial analysis.

mara_finance: once customer consents, tag me with the ticket id and i'll sign off.

olivia_support: customer replied — they authorize the transfer. they provided admin name and last 4 of phone: ****-1234. ready for reversal when billing runs it. :white_check_mark:

jordan_ops: scheduling the reversal window at 16:30 UTC. i'll do a dry-run first and post logs.

anya_cs: great — thanks everyone. i'll update the customer thread and close loop after reversal. :thumbsup:
